description: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer built to write, run, and test code, handle tickets, and build applications.
auth_notes: Uses a Bearer token (`cog_`-prefixed service user API key or personal access token) in the Authorization header.
credential_notes: Requires signing up for a paid Devin plan (Individual or Teams) via the web app to provision credentials.
api_notes: Covers session management, enterprise analytics, audit logs, knowledge notes, playbooks, secrets, and repository setups.
mcp_notes: Official MCP support is provided via the Devin MCP server maintained by Cognition Labs.
rationale: The API is fully documented and functional, but API credential generation requires access to a paid Devin account plan.

evidence.note: Describes token and principal model using Bearer authentication with cog_ keys.
Mentions signing up via app.devin.ai with Individual and Teams plans available.
Outlines REST API structure for organization and enterprise scopes.
References MCP (Model Context Protocol) and Devin MCP support in documentation index.
